title: Character Actor Projection
objective: Create a reusable SAA actor reference over existing Character/NPC/Creature owner identity and renderer-neutral appearance projections, using ARI-governed presentation resources without mutating canonical entity or appearance truth and without beginning the SAA-06 pose/expression/view selector.
acceptance: Each SAA actor has stable actor identity and explicit reference to an existing Character/NPC/Creature owner record rather than copying canonical entity truth.

Actor projection stores versioned renderer-neutral appearance/projection references supplied by CAPP/PPIA-compatible owners and does not redefine anatomy, mechanics, equipment ownership or live state.
Renderable presentation resources are referenced through ARI identity/provenance/rights references rather than embedded or duplicated by default.
The same actor projection can be reused across pages/panels while preserving stable entity and appearance-reference identity.
Unsupported, missing or stale appearance/resource references remain explicit fail-closed projection state rather than fabricating a usable actor.
Projection emits presentation bindings consumable by SAA-03 composition without mutating Character, Scene, ARI, CAPP/PPIA or PAPT/PCA owner truth.
Actor creation and selection have keyboard/textual equivalents and do not require drag-and-drop.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available governed projections; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-06 pose/expression/view/frame selection and all later SAA/export/share/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owner domains retain canonical identity, anatomy, mechanics and live-state authority.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; PAPT/PCA retain reusable production primitives; ARI retains resource identity, provenance and rights authority.
SAA-05 creates reusable presentation actor references only; it does not author or silently mutate canonical appearance truth.
Pose, expression, view and animation-frame variant selection belongs to SAA-06.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: Establish causal RED for stable actor identity, owner-record references, versioned appearance projection references, ARI presentation resources, fail-closed stale/missing states, reusable panel/page projection and accessible selection; then implement only SAA-05.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-05 after verified SAA-04 closeout.
